stem.text: A cylindrical steel rod with negligible weight has a diameter of $1.5\,\text{cm}$ and a length of $5.2\,\text{cm}$.
The rod is firmly attached at the top end.
The rod is firmly attached to a machine at the other end that applies a constant force of $363\,\text{N}$ to the rod.
This causes the rod to extend to a length of $7.4\,\text{cm}$ and to have a minimum diameter of $0.60\,\text{cm}$ in the position shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of an unextended vertical rod fixed to a support at its top. Labels: unextended rod, 5.2 cm (length), 1.5 cm (diameter).
Diagram of an extended vertical rod between a grey block at its top and a grey block at its bottom, with a narrowed section. Labels: extended rod, 7.4 cm, minimum diameter of 0.60 cm.

stem.text: What is the maximum stress acting on the steel rod when the length is $7.4\,\text{cm}$?
